# COUI

> COUI is a Compose Multiplatform port of the ColorOS 17 (COUI 17) component kit for Android, iOS, macOS, Desktop (JVM) and Web. Maven group: io.github.suqi8.coui.kmp (modules coui-ui, coui-preference, coui-blur, coui-icons, coui-squircle, coui-nav).

Rules for writing COUI screens:

- Wrap the app in COUITheme(controller = ThemeController(ColorSchemeMode.System)); put every page in a COUI Scaffold (Overlay* dialogs, sheets and menus need it).
- Page = Scaffold + TopAppBar(scrollBehavior = COUIScrollBehavior()) + LazyColumn with Modifier.overScrollVertical() and the bar's nestedScrollConnection.
- Settings content = PreferenceCategory + Card + CardListGroup { item { SwitchPreference / ArrowPreference / OverlayDropdownPreference / SliderPreference } }. No hand-made dividers or row paddings.
- Colours from COUITheme.colorScheme, text from COUITheme.textStyles.
- COUI 17 material blur: record the page with rememberLayerBackdrop + Modifier.layerBackdrop, pass it to TopAppBarGlow, Modifier.couiMaterialBlur (dialogs, sheets), LocalPopupMaterialBlur (menus) and LocalMaterialBackdrop (buttons, bars); fall back to opaque when isRuntimeShaderSupported() is false.
- Strings in Compose resources values/ and values-zh/; never store display text as state.
- A search typed into under a top bar is linked with the bar like the ColorOS Settings search: TopAppBarSearchBar in the bar's bottomContent, rememberTopAppBarSearchState passed as the bar's searchState, the page under Modifier.topAppBarSearchContent and the results in their own list under Modifier.topAppBarSearchResults. No static TopAppBarSearchSlot + InputField filter, no swapped-in search row.
- Porting Miuix (top.yukonga.miuix.kmp) or COUI 1.x code: rename the colour and text style slots to the official names (onBackground -> labelPrimary, surface -> backgroundWithCard, background -> surface on floating panels / backgroundElevated elsewhere, main -> bodyXL, title4 -> headlineS, ...), there are no aliases. Tables in the migration guide below.
- Wrap a list popup with the button that opens it: Box { IconButton(...); OverlayListPopup(...) }. Placed directly in a top bar actions row it pushes the button aside while shown.

## Docs

- [Getting started](/coui/guide/getting-started): dependencies and theme
- [Migrating from Miuix](/coui/guide/migration.md) and [Upgrading from COUI 1.x](/coui/guide/upgrading.md): every renamed slot and API
- [llms-full.txt](/coui/llms-full.txt): the whole English guide and component reference in one file; any page is also served as Markdown by adding .md to its address
- [Writing with AI](/coui/guide/ai): the coui-app agent skill (.claude/skills/coui-app in the repository)
- [COUI Canvas](/coui/canvas/): sketch COUI screens in the browser; agents can write designs for it following /coui/canvas/agent.md
- [Blur effects](/coui/guide/blur): material blur presets and backdrops
- [Components](/coui/components/): every component with properties and examples
- [Example app](/coui/example/): every component running in the browser
